program_overview.title: C++ Programming Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: The language beneath everything fast: fundamentals to modern C++, templates, concurrency and systems programming, in ten honest months.
program_overview.description:
C++ remains the language of engines, trading systems, embedded firmware and every place performance is non-negotiable, and it rewards exactly one approach: patient depth. This live online masterclass builds it in three real phases: fundamentals and object-oriented C++ learned properly, then the layer that makes C++ modern, the STL used fluently, templates understood rather than feared, smart pointers and RAII as habits, and finally the systems layer: concurrency, memory at depth, and the OS-adjacent programming that makes C++ engineers valuable. A finale month ships a capstone and sits the final exam.

The pace is honest: ten teaching months at two live classes a week plus four to six hours of practice, with two more months in hand. Problem sets after every class, monthly mixed reviews, cumulative phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate with a free retest. Real memory, real speed, depth over dopamine.
what_makes_this_different: The memory model taught with pictures and patience: pointers, RAII and ownership as understanding, not folklore
Modern C++ as the default: smart pointers, move semantics and the STL the way current codebases use them
Templates demystified: generic programming as a tool, not a trauma
A real systems phase: concurrency and OS-adjacent programming, the valuable end of C++
An honest 10-month arc with 2 months in hand
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams and a final exam with a free retest

faqs.question: What does this C++ masterclass cover?
faqs.answer: Three real phases plus a finale: fundamentals and object-oriented C++ learned patiently; modern C++, STL fluency, templates, smart pointers and move semantics; systems programming, concurrency, memory at depth and performance; then a capstone month ending in the final exam. The famous hard parts get pictures and patience, and the modern idioms are the default throughout.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn C++ properly?
faqs.answer: Ten months of teaching at 2 live classes a week plus 4 to 6 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for learners who need them. The three teaching phases build the language and its real-world domain; the finale month ships a capstone and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Is C++ still worth learning?
faqs.answer: Wherever performance is non-negotiable, C++ remains the answer: game engines, trading systems, embedded, robotics, browsers and the AI infrastructure layer itself. It is also the best teacher of fundamentals in the industry: engineers fluent in C++ pick up everything else faster, and interviews know it.
